Title: Now available: Azure Service Fabric Mesh fall refresh

Body.Content:
Enhancements include:

  • Automatic scale of stateless instances.
  • Support for secret, network, gateway, and volume resources.
  • Support for inline secrets
  • Support for multiple-ingress and routing.
  • Support for mounting Azure Files and Service Fabric Reliable Volumes to containers.

Learn more
